title: Fixed-exponent alternating Cech complex
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge1$, and $e\in\mathbf Z^{n+1}$. Put $N_e=\{i:e_i<0\}$. Define $C_e^\bullet$ to be the cochain complex with degree-$p$ term the free $A$-module on subsets $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n\}$ satisfying $|J|=p+1$ and $N_e\subseteq J$, and differential $d[J]=\sum_{k\notin J}(-1)^{\#\{j\in J:j<k\}}[J\cup\{k\}]$.
